Right cell shows the EXACT same plane at identical scale, facing left, as a buckled falling wreck, jagged torn roof above the cabin and fractured wing edges, bent nose and broken windows, recognizable original ivory and turquoise colors. Damage contained in sprite, no clouds or detached debris. In both cells keep the silhouette low and long and anchor fuselage center at the midpoint of its cell.
